issue_context.title: DllImportGenerator conversion code fix should make the containing types partial
issue_context.body:
Right now the code fix to convert to `GeneratedDllImport` doesn't make any containing types `partial`. This can result in build failures after running the code fix (which makes the `DllImport` methods `partial`).

cc: @AaronRobinsonMSFT @elinor-fung

review_comments: Maybe also have a middle or outer class that is already partial?
